name: Kosai (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kosai city emblem in blue: a disc with a white crescent and a small ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kosai, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1972.

features.role: Kosai city emblem — a disc with a white crescent and a small ring, like a stylised character
